cases.name: Receipts.GeneratedTests.MetadataGenericStructDiagnosticLeakTests.NoMsgPackDiagnosticsForClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly
cases.message: Expected diagnostics.Where(d => d.Id.StartsWith("MsgPack", StringComparison.Ordinal) || d.Id == "AD0001") to be empty because types from a referenced assembly are not diagnosed by the consuming compilation, but found at least one item {error MsgPack004: Properties and fields of MessagePackObject-attributed types require either KeyAttribute or IgnoreMemberAttribute: global::Lib.Item<int>.Value}.
